question: Kajari festival is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kajari festival:-**

 
 
• **The Kajari festival in Chhattisgarh is a monsoon festival that is celebrated by the farmers of the state. **
 
• **It is a time to bid farewell to the monsoons and to start the preparations for a fresh harvest. **
 
• The festival is also associated with the sowing season for wheat and barley.
 
• The Kajari festival begins on the ninth day after the Shravan Amavasya and continues till the Kajari Purnima, which is the full moon day in the month of Bhadrapada.
 
• The festival is particularly important to the women of Chhattisgarh, who perform a variety of rituals and customs to seek the blessings of the goddess Bhagwati for a good harvest and the well-being of their families.
